# Memory Capture: my grandmother's kitchen

Recorded from a voice note, June 2026. Raw recall — the writer's own words.

The kitchen always smelled of soy sauce and star anise. There was an enamel mug
by the stove that nobody was allowed to move. My grandmother Mei cooked there
every morning before the rest of the house woke up.

She would call out "come and eat" and we would all sit down at once.

We moved away in 1978. I was seven years old that summer.
